summary: SurgePays, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to report the formation of LWP-SURGE, LLC, a Wyoming LLC intended as the vehicle for a proposed joint venture with All Prepaid, LLC (LWP). The company expects to hold 51% and manage the entity, with LWP holding 49%. No definitive agreements have been executed, and the venture has no operations or assets. The filing notes no material effect on financials. This is a preliminary corporate development, not a special situation; no deal terms, premium, or binding obligations are stated. Watch for definitive agreements or further disclosures.
